summary: Iteration 5 - Frontend-only validation of the Performance dead-zone bug fix. Scrolled through the entire Performance chapter (data-testid=chapter-performance, h-[230vh]) sampling 21 scroll positions and inspecting stat and bridge opacities live. The four giant STATS ('1.85', '1,850', '400', '700') each animate in/out in sequence across roughly the first ~50-78% of the scrubbed timeline, and the hand-off cue data-testid='performance-bridge' ('Next / The Machine' + chevron) fades from 0 to ~1 starting at ~48% of the section and holds at opacity 1 through the end into the Machine chapter. Max consecutive 'dead' samples (no stat visible AND bridge<0.15) = 1 out of 21 (just the very first sample before the first stat fades in) - the previously reported empty tail is gone. Regression checks all pass: canvas renders, loader clears, menu-item-performance and menu-item-machine both smooth-scroll (no reload), machine-system-energy/thermal/aerodynamics toggle aria-pressed=true and update machine-readout accordingly. Zero console errors captured during the run.

issues: Bridge cue reaches full opacity at ~50% of Performance scroll and then holds static at opacity 1 for the remaining ~50% (steps 10-20). This is the intended fill of the previously-dead tail per the fix spec, but consider adding a subtle secondary motion (e.g., chevron pulse translateY, or slight scale/parallax on the 'The Machine' text) during the hold phase so the last ~1000px of scroll feels progressively animated rather than a long static hold. Not a bug - polish suggestion only.

critical_code_review_comments: Performance.jsx: bridge fully opaque by t=0.92 (0.8 + 0.12) meaning the last ~8% of the scrubbed timeline (~165vh of scroll) has zero animated deltas. Consider extending the bridge tween duration (e.g., 0.2) or adding a follow-up yPercent/scale tween near t=0.95 so the entire tail carries motion.
STATS timeline: the 4 stats occupy 0..0.78 while the bridge fades 0.8..0.92 - there is a small quiet gap from 0.78 to 0.8, negligible in practice (tested fine).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Performance dead-zone fix verified working in iteration 5. The bridge (data-testid=performance-bridge) is now the meaningful content for the tail of the Performance section. If future changes to Performance.jsx are made, re-run the 21-step scroll sample and verify max_dead_streak stays <= 2 and the bridge reaches opacity >= 0.9 by the last quarter of the section. Machine chapter regression buttons (machine-system-energy/thermal/aerodynamics) and menu navigation are all healthy.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Performance was 320vh tall with all stat animations completing well before the section end, leaving a large static tail before the Machine chapter. Fix reduced height to 230vh, packed the 4 stats into the first 78% of the scrubbed timeline, and added a fading-in 'The Machine' hand-off cue (data-testid=performance-bridge) starting at t=0.8. Verification: sampled 21 scroll positions across the section - every position except the very first shows either an active stat (opacity > 0.15) or the bridge (opacity > 0.15). Dead-zone eliminated.
